title: Contract
description: Legal agreement or contract document between a business and a client. Tracks contract details, financial terms, duration, status, and specific terms and conditions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the contract record

contract_number.description: Unique contract reference number or identifier used for legal and administrative purposes

client_id.description: Foreign key reference to the client or party the contract is with

title.description: Short descriptive title or name of the contract

description.description: Detailed description of the contract's purpose, scope, and objectives

value.description: Total monetary value or contract amount agreed upon

currency.description: ISO currency code for the contract value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

start_date.description: Date when the contract becomes effective and obligations begin

end_date.description: Date when the contract expires or terminates

status.description: Current status of the contract (e.g., draft, active, expired, terminated, renewed)

terms.description: Detailed terms and conditions, obligations, and clauses of the contract
